headlines.description: — Donovan Mitchell scored 31 points, Evan Mobley had 22 points and tied a career high with 19 rebounds, and the Cleveland Cavaliers defeated the Atlanta Hawks 122-116 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Donovan Mitchell and Evan Mobley help Cavaliers hold off Hawks 122-116

headlines.description: — Paolo Banchero had 20 points and eight rebounds, Desmond Bane added 18 points and six assists and the Orlando Magic beat the Minnesota Timberwolves 132-120 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Magic beat Timberwolves 132-120 as Paolo Banchero scores 20 and Orlando wins 4th straight

headlines.description: — Cade Cunningham had 13 points and 10 assists in his return from injury as the Detroit Pistons beat the Milwaukee Bucks 137-111 in their home finale on...
headlines.shortLinkText: Cade Cunningham has double-double in return from injury as Pistons rout Bucks 137-111

headlines.description: — Nikola Jokic had 14 points, 15 rebounds and 10 assists for his 34th triple-double of the season, and Denver beat the Memphis Grizzlies 136-119 on Wednesday night for the Nuggets’ 10th straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jokic has his 34th triple-double, Nuggets beat the Grizzlies 136-119 for 10th straight win

events.name: Portland Trail Blazers at San Antonio Spurs

headlines.description: — De'Aaron Fox had 25 points and the San Antonio Spurs kept rolling even with Victor Wembanyama and Stephon Castle sidelined by injuries, defeating the Portland Trail Blazers 112-101 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fox scores 25 points to lead short-handed Spurs past Trail Blazers 112-101

events.name: Oklahoma City Thunder at LA Clippers

headlines.description: — Chet Holmgren had 30 points and 14 rebounds, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander added 20 points and 11 assists, and the Oklahoma City Thunder clinched the NBA's best regular-season record with a...
headlines.shortLinkText: Holmgren scores 30, Thunder clinch NBA's best regular-season record in 128-110 victory over Clippers

headlines.description: — Devin Booker scored 37 points, Dillon Brooks added 28 and the Phoenix Suns edged the short-handed Dallas Mavericks 112-107 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Devin Booker scores 37, Suns clinch No. 7 spot in West with a 112-107 win
